title: Historical evidence needs structural and temporal authority axes
summary: DAEDALUS verified that historical TradingView experiences remain isolated from model training, but aggregate API/UI projections can discard UNVERIFIED_TIMEZONE and label those same records MEASURED. Combined with AION's structural-admission audit, the correct shared state is two-axis: structurally measured does not imply temporally qualified, and neither implies scientific or trading authority.
accepted_findings: DAEDALUS: historical CSV/XLSX experiences are diverted to immutable trade_experience memory; requested model slots do not train on them and they cannot enter RUNTIME_CLOSURE_CONFIG.
DAEDALUS: individual experience/import records preserve time_quality=UNVERIFIED_TIMEZONE, but aggregate summaries and UI cards omit it and can emit status=MEASURED.

AION: duplicate TIDE columns are structurally identical for two hashed files under integrity/3, but raw-source replay, indicator provenance, hosted verification and performance authority remain unestablished.
FLOW: the 05:00Z BTC turnover anomaly was followed by a 06:00Z joint range-volume expansion with cross-provider range corroboration; this is a one-episode observation only.
MACRO: the most recent bounded review found no macro state transition beyond the already recorded multi-channel refined-product regime.
rejected_findings: Reject MEASURED as sufficient authority when the underlying group is UNVERIFIED_TIMEZONE.
Reject session, regime, time-of-day or duration inference from historical groups until timezone/source-clock qualification is explicit.
Reject structural admission, exact duplicate equality or descriptive P&L aggregation as model/performance qualification.
Reject the single BTC turnover-to-expansion sequence as a learned precursor, causal flow mechanism or persistent cross-market regime.
Reject current GitHub-native v3 receipts as substantive inference; they explicitly retain deterministic_liveness and SUBSTANTIVE_AI_INFERENCE_NOT_EXECUTED.
conflicts: The data layer preserves UNVERIFIED_TIMEZONE while the aggregate/UI layer can display MEASURED and clock-derived first/last timestamps without the temporal warning.
AION's source/feature qualification increases structural confidence, while absent raw-byte replay and provider-time attestation keep provenance confidence limited.

Current restored-five health is heterogeneous: Alpha 11:25Z is exact-slot verified; Advanced CSV 11:15Z, Apex 11:45Z and Flow 11:35Z are missing; Robustness 11:05Z is missing after a verified 10:05Z slot.
Current v3 AION, Flow and Macro slots were first adjudicated missing and then persisted as late native liveness; DAEDALUS 11:48Z persisted in the same deterministic cycle.
blockers: Aggregate experience APIs and UI cards do not propagate time_quality/time_interpretation or counts by temporal qualification.
Session/regime/time-of-day feature construction is not explicitly blocked on timezone-qualified groups.
Raw chart bytes and provider/export configuration remain unavailable for independent AION replay.
No protected OOS or cost-valid performance evidence exists for historical or BTC precursor claims.
Restored-five continues to depend on mixed exact-native and watchdog-only durability states.
next_highest_value_integration_target: Implement one projection-safe evidence lattice carried unchanged through storage, summaries, UI and research packets: STRUCTURAL_QUALITY={BLOCKED,QUALIFIED} x TEMPORAL_QUALITY={UNVERIFIED_TIMEZONE,EXACT_SOURCE_CLOCK} x SCIENTIFIC_AUTHORITY={DESCRIPTIVE,TESTED,OOS_QUALIFIED}. Replace generic MEASURED with STRUCTURALLY_MEASURED_TIME_UNQUALIFIED when appropriate, expose counts by time quality, and fail closed on session/regime/time-of-day features until temporal qualification is proven.

owner_job_status_dependencies.dependency: Route temporally unqualified historical groups away from clock/session-dependent inference.
Preserve structural and temporal states independently across imports, summaries, UI and research projections.
Consecutive exact-slot native receipts; current restored-five has one exact lane and multiple missing/watchdog lanes while v3 remains late-native liveness.
Prevent descriptive UI labels, structural qualification and liveness receipts from inheriting temporal, scientific or execution authority.

athena.finding: Treat UNVERIFIED_TIMEZONE as an explicit uncertainty gate; historical groups may remain descriptively useful but cannot support clock/session-dependent routing.

janus.finding: Add independent structural, temporal and scientific authority dimensions to the project twin and preserve them through aggregate/API/UI projections without label collapse.

infrastructure.finding: GitHub-native v3 ultimately persisted current AION/Flow/Macro/DAEDALUS liveness, several after grace; restored-five currently has Alpha exact-slot verified while Advanced CSV, Apex, Flow and the latest Robustness slot are missing/watchdog-dependent.

helios_prime.finding: Integrate the two-axis historical-evidence lattice across LearningFabric, UI and research packets, preventing MEASURED, structural qualification or liveness from inheriting temporal/scientific authority.
